intro: If you want a place to stay in central Amnat Charoen that's easy to reach, with plenty of parking and a friendly price, LJ The Emerald Hotel is a name that travelers and people here on business have come to know · An in-town hotel on Arun Prasert Road, near the City Pillar Shrine, with fully air-conditioned rooms, a large car park for up to 400 vehicles, and banquet rooms for seminars and weddings · Rooms start from about THB 550/night for a standard room, a straightforward choice for anyone who values location and value over polish.

body.html: LJ The Emerald Hotel sits at 904 Moo 9, Arun Prasert Road, Bung, Mueang Amnat Charoen — right in the heart of town on the main road, easy to come and go, about 1 km from the Amnat Charoen City Pillar Shrine and around 3 km from Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddhist Park · It's a hotel of around 46 rooms that locals and travelers along the Ubon–Mukdahan route know well; Amnat Charoen is a small town with few in-town options, so this hotel is one of the main go-to choices for anyone needing an overnight stay.

What guests mention most is the large car park, with space for around 400 vehicles — something you rarely find at a small-town hotel, handy for self-drivers and groups · Rooms are air-conditioned with a TV, fridge, private bathroom and free Wi-Fi, enough for an overnight stay · Many reviews say rooms are clean enough, staff are friendly and some speak a little English, and the price is good value for this level.
"Clean room, very spacious parking, friendly staff, and quiet surroundings with rice paddies around — great value for an overnight stop in town."

Another plus is the quiet setting, surrounded by rice paddies, and the hotel has banquet, meeting and seminar rooms, making it popular for weddings and functions in the province · There's an on-site restaurant, CCTV and 24-hour security, which helps it feel safe for solo travelers or anyone here for a few days of work.

The honest caveats — service isn't as polished as a hotel in a bigger city · Some reviews note the staff lack service experience, English is limited, so being able to speak Thai helps · Recurring issues include cleanliness that's inconsistent and not done every day, few power outlets in the room and bathroom, and a fairly basic breakfast (eggs, sausages, bread, coffee) · Some rooms also pick up noise from an adjacent student dormitory.

In short, LJ The Emerald Hotel suits anyone wanting a central Amnat Charoen stay with plenty of parking at an easy price, for an overnight stop, a business trip, or a function in the province · An overall score of about 6.0 from real reviews reflects exactly that — good location, large car park, good value, but service and upkeep that's patchy in places · Set your expectations and lean on the value, and most guests have a comfortable night.

honestSummary: LJ The Emerald Hotel is a central Amnat Charoen option with a great location, huge parking and an easy price, well suited to an overnight stop, a business trip, or a function in the province · The trade-off is accepting service that isn't polished, limited English, and upkeep that's inconsistent in places.
honestChecks: If you're driving yourself or traveling as a group — this delivers, with parking for up to 400 cars → but accept service that's less polished than a big-city hotel.
If you don't speak Thai — staff English is limited → have a translation app ready, or jot down your address and requests in Thai in advance.
If you expect a strong breakfast and high cleanliness — breakfast is basic and cleanliness is inconsistent → set expectations and lean on the value and location.

tips.title: Easy self-drive, plenty of parking
tips.body: The car park is very large with room for up to 400 cars, so you won't worry about parking — ideal for self-drivers or groups.

tips.title: Ask for a room away from the dorm
tips.body: Some rooms pick up noise from an adjacent student dormitory. When booking, ask for a room on the quieter side or a higher floor to avoid the noise.

tips.title: Pack a power strip
tips.body: There are few power outlets in the room and bathroom, so if you need to charge several devices, a power strip makes things easier.

tips.title: Visit Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddhist Park
tips.body: About 3 km from the hotel, this large Buddha image is Amnat Charoen's headline sight. Go in the morning.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — LJ The Emerald Hotel, Amnat Charoen

faq.q: Where is LJ The Emerald Hotel in Amnat Charoen?
faq.a: It's at 904 Moo 9, Arun Prasert Road, Bung, Mueang District, Amnat Charoen, right in the heart of town on the main road · About 1 km from the City Pillar Shrine and around 3 km from Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddhist Park, with easy access in and out of town.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from about THB 550/night for a Standard room · Superior runs around THB 650, Deluxe around THB 800, and a Family room around THB 1,000 · Prices vary by season, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is there parking and a pool?
faq.a: There is free parking, and it's very large — space for around 400 vehicles, ideal for self-drivers and groups · There is no swimming pool, but there are banquet and meeting rooms and an on-site restaurant.

faq.q: What are the rooms and service like?
faq.a: Rooms are air-conditioned with a TV, fridge, private bathroom and free Wi-Fi; many call them clean enough and good value · Just bear in mind that service isn't polished, staff English is limited, there are few power outlets, and breakfast is fairly basic.

faq.q: Can the hotel host functions or seminars?
faq.a: Yes · LJ The Emerald Hotel has banquet, meeting and seminar rooms and is popular for weddings and functions in Amnat Charoen province · Combined with the large car park, it can comfortably handle larger groups of guests.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone wanting a central Amnat Charoen stay with plenty of parking at an easy price, for an overnight stop, a business trip, or a function · Less suited to those wanting a new hotel or a resort with a swimming pool.
